topics.inclusion_rule: Include studies that map ultrasound tongue images (with or without lip video) to acoustic features or a waveform with a trained network, and name the mapping architecture. Boundary: exclude ultrasound-to-text recognition without synthesis, contour tracking, ultrasound prediction from other signals and reviews (they inflate the pattern match, an upper bound); spatial transformer networks count as CNNs, not as attention models; count versions once by key.

Include studies that synthesize speech or acoustic features from ultrasound tongue images (with or without lip video) and evaluate the output; classify the output measures used (MCD or other spectral distance, MUSHRA or MOS ratings, listener transcription or identification, ASR on the synthesized speech). Boundary: exclude recognition-only studies, contour tracking and reviews (they inflate the pattern match, an upper bound); count versions once by key.
